name: Illness

text.fail: A fever sweeps through the colony: every survivor still in its care takes one ordinary wound, and morale drops by 1.
text.bonus: Two cards beyond the need lift morale by 1.

notes: Official name Illness (was our Sickness). Medicine symbol, one ordinary wound token on every non-exiled survivor, lose 1 morale (settles conflict C5). Id kept for saves.
